name: Ollama
desc: Run large language models locally with simple commands.
overview: Ollama is a local model runner that allows users to download and run LLMs entirely offline, including Llama, Mistral, Phi, Gemma, and many community models. It provides a simple CLI and API, supports GPU acceleration, and is widely used for privacy‑focused workflows.
benefits: Fully local execution with no cloud dependency
Simple model installation and fast GPU inference
drawbacks: Requires a capable GPU for larger models
Limited UI unless paired with tools like Open WebUI

name: LM Studio
desc: Desktop app for running and experimenting with local LLMs.
overview: LM Studio is a cross‑platform desktop application that makes running local LLMs easy. It includes a model browser, chat UI, GPU acceleration, and an OpenAI‑compatible local API server. It is popular among developers who want local inference without command‑line complexity.
benefits: User‑friendly interface for local model management
Runs an OpenAI‑compatible API for local apps
drawbacks: High VRAM requirements for large models

name: Cursor
desc: AI-powered code editor with local model support.
overview: Cursor is an AI coding environment built on top of VS Code, offering agentic coding, refactoring, and repository‑wide reasoning. It supports both cloud models and local models via an OpenAI‑compatible endpoint, making it ideal for privacy‑focused development.
benefits: Deep codebase understanding and agentic coding tools
Supports local inference through custom model endpoints
drawbacks: Paid plans required for heavy usage
Local model performance depends on hardware

name: Open WebUI
desc: Local web interface for running and managing LLMs.
overview: Open WebUI is a self‑hosted chat interface that connects to local LLM backends like Ollama, LM Studio, and custom APIs. It includes RAG tools, file uploads, multi‑model routing, extensions, and a modern UI. It is widely used for local AI workflows.
benefits: Works with multiple local model backends
drawbacks: Requires manual setup for advanced features
Depends on external model runners like Ollama
